sn47.44:1.1: Sato bhikkhave bhikkhu vihareyya || ayam vo amhākam anusāsanī || || Kathañca bhikkhave {bhikkhu} sato hoti || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati || Vedanāsu || Citte || Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassam || || Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sato hoti || || Sato bhikkhave bhikkhu vihareyya || ayaṃ vo amhākam anusāsanī ti || ||
